hook.name: InitialBuyNFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFTStrategy pools that collects trading fees with a decaying buy fee (starting at 99%, decreasing 1% per block to a floor of 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Fees are distributed 80% to the NFT collection, 10% to PunkStrategy, and 10% to a configured fee address. The factory's initial purchase is exempt from the buy fee.
